text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober hurt herself during<n>training, so I go to
see how she's<n>doing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You came all this way just to check<n>on me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You didn't need to do that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to worry about me.<n>Just think of
this as a<n>longer-than-usual break.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't really hurt anymore, and if<n>anything, you
fussing over me makes<n>it harder to relax...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't really hurt anymore, and if<n>anything, you
fussing over me makes<n>it harder to relax...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll head back to training after resting<n>a bit more.
You can go on ahead.
choice_data_list: No rush. Just focus on getting better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I thought you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I rush back and it gets worse,<n>you'll just fuss
over me even more<n>and never leave...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I know you're worried about me,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll rest.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober looks a little frustrated,<n>but she
agrees to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not. And it's really not a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A little bruise like this isn't going to<n>stop me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ungh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. I-I don't suppose you'd<n>believe me if I said I
was fine... Ow...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she shouldn't be moving<n>her leg yet.
Mejiro Dober is visibly<n>crestfallen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after I leave the infirmary,<n>Mejiro Dober
catches up with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't hurt anymore, so I<n>shouldn't have a
problem moving<n>around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's get started. I have to make up<n>for all the time
I lost.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her injury doesn't bother her too<n>much, so Mejiro
Dober and I restart<n>training without pushing her too
hard!
